notes.title: Release 5 - Screen Capture and Live Video Conversion to 3D in Real-time
notes.content:

notes.title: Release 4.1.2 - Meta Quest 3S Support, Enhanced Help, MP4 Progress Viewing
notes.content:
[olist]
[*][b]Meta Quest 3S Support[/b]
    The Meta Quest 3S headset has been added to the list of supported devices.

[*][b]Enhanced Help and Documentation[/b]
    - [b]Context-Sensitive Help:[/b] Integrated help links and buttons directly within the user interface to provide context-sensitive guidance.
    - Improved accessibility of documentation via the Help button across multiple screens.

[*][b]Real-Time MP4 Output Viewing[/b]
    - Converted output files in MP4 format can now be viewed progressively during the conversion process.
    - This feature complements existing support for being able to view MKV output files during conversion.

[*][b]Early Conversion Completion[/b]
    - A new [b]"Finish" button[/b] allows users to terminate conversions partway through while finalising the partially converted video file.
    - Enables faster workflows for users satisfied with the early stages of the conversion.

[*][b]Expanded Error Messaging[/b]
    - Additional error messages detect and guide resolution for more potential system configuration issues.
    - Enhanced troubleshooting feedback for GPU driver updates and missing tool dependencies.
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Important User Guidance[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Support Channels:[/b] If encountering issues, please use [url=https://discord.com/invite/hBgxEERNac]Discord[/url] or email for assistance. The vast majority of issues encountered by users are system configuration specific rather than with the Stream to 3D tool itself.

[*][b]System Configuration Checklist:[/b]
    - Ensure your [b]GPU driver[/b] is up to date. Conversion and streaming via FFMPeg may fail if your GPU driver is not up to date.
    - Watch for conflicts with previously installed software, such as:
        [list]
        [*][b]MPC-HC plugins[/b] (as part of the K-Lite Codec Pack)
        [*][b]AviSynth+ libraries[/b]
        [/list]
    - If tool dependencies are accidentally removed, they can be re-installed by following the guidance available in the documentation here:  
      [url=https://iwantaholodeck.com/stream-to-3d-settings/#:~:text=installing%20Tools%20if%20Stream%20to%203D%20was%20Purchased%20from%20the%20Steam%20Store]Tools Installation Guide[/url]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Release 4.1 - Further 3D Depth Effect Enhancements
notes.content: Release 4.1 further extends the 3D capabilities of Stream to 3D, supporting fine grained tuning. This update directly enhances the depth of the 3D produced, by allowing tuning of the Temporal Depth Offset. A sweet spot appears to be using a Temporal Depth Offset of 1.25 frames instead of 1 Frame (as was the fixed interval in previous releases of Stream to 3D). The Configuration Wizard provides suitable high level options. The enhannced technique invokes frame rate interpolation to enable the approach. This release also fixes an issue with the "Auto" mode of the Configuration Wizard, related to the correct reloading of settings.

notes.title: Stream to 3D Release 4.0.1 is now available! A Major Leap Forward Inspired by Us
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of Stream to 3D version 4.0.1, a substantial update that leverages your feedback to significantly enhance; the 3D effect, usability and device compatibility.

This update brings groundbreaking improvements, making 3D conversion more intuitive, accessible, and satisfying for users worldwide. Highlights of this version include:

[b]Graduated 3D Effect Mode:[/b] Introducing a new graduated 3D effect mode that allows users to customize their viewing experience with depth effects ranging from "subtle and comfortable" to "deep and intense."

[b]Enhanced Device Compatibility: [/b]With the new Configuration Wizard, users can now optimize their 3D content for a wider range of devices, ensuring the highest quality experience.

[b]Intelligent Configuration Wizard:[/b] Automatically detects screen and video resolutions to select the best 3D output format, tailoring the conversion process to match device and video specifics.

[b]Advanced Video and System Analysis:[/b] Offers optimized output by assessing video characteristics and system performance, enabling a tailored conversion process that maximizes quality.

Expanded Frame Rate Support: Improved compatibility with a variety of frame rates ensures global compatibility and precision, adjusting intelligently based on the video's origin.

[b]Customizable Quality Preferences:[/b] Users can now specify their desired quality settings through the Configuration Wizard, balancing processing speed with visual fidelity.
